protocol.authorization: User authorized a small P-VR/P-PRM training comparison; no automatic expansion to 6M.
protocol.initial: common Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B base and seed17 zero LoRA, never old trained A/B

control.matching: same prompt order, rollout batch count, samples, initialization and optimizer; actual tokens and walltime reported separately

optimizer.source: official train_pure.sh LR5e-7, CLI betas .9/.95 and clip1; single-card torch optimizer replaces DeepSpeed

sampling.response_seed: 17 + 32 * zero_based_batch_index + row_index; eight distinct seeds per question; same schedule across arms

protocol.checkpointing: atomic checkpoint every batch, with LoRA/optimizer/RNG/counters; verify all hashes before resume; do not regenerate completed batches

monitoring.collapse: in BOTH adjacent non-overlapping last-5-batch windows: decoded-empty >=25%, OR (short<=32 content tokens AND no reliably parsed answer) >=50%; short correct answers alone never trigger
monitoring.technical_stop: nonfinite, frozen parameter drift, wrong boundary/duplicate normalization, or all-zero undefined official normalization: save failure, stop; no invented reward, resampling or hidden skip

evaluation.validation: fixed 64 of existing policy-held-out validation set at steps0,10,20,40; descriptive only, PRM800K overlap disclosed
evaluation.final: same common-stage checkpoint, greedy MATH500500 and GSM8K1319, original repaired verifier/prompt/cap, no PRM reranking
evaluation.selection: never select best test checkpoint; if either arm collapses, stop BOTH at shared completed stage
evaluation.uncertainty: paired question bootstrap95CI, single training seed; small differences or interval spanning0 are inconclusive

runtime.backend: single-card LoRA/vLLM setup only; official OpenRLHF signal/loss functions
runtime.sync: FP32 merged COPIES to vLLM; never merge/unmerge live actor, frozen reference remains unchanged

protocol.preserved: all old A/B and veRL/OpenRLHF no-update artifacts remain immutable
